thread:
marta: quick sync — planning to flip feature flag "alt-rerank_v2" to 10% US-prod tomorrow 09:00 PT. Goal: validate quality and latency effect. any objections?

ajay: can we do 5% first? last change had slight latency bump for long contexts.

sam: 10% ok if we gate by route. prefer: only /search endpoints, not /chat.

marta: good call. updated plan -> 10% of search only. also want stopping rules: if error rate + latency.

leo: proposed stopping rules: >1.5x 95th latency for 5min rolling OR >0.5% absolute increase in 5xx rate vs baseline for 10min.

nina: add quality regression: if CTR_down on rerank_by_clicks > 2% absolute over 1h? but noisy.

ajay: prefer relative lift metric on top-k precision. baseline window last 24h. maybe: -1.5% relative in top-k precision for 30m.

marta: let's combine: latency OR error OR quality. concrete: latency 95th > 1.5x over baseline 15m, errors +0.5% absolute 10m, precision drop -1.5% relative 30m. sounds good?

sam: yup. also add automatic rollback flag in rollout config. set killswitch TTL?

leo: rollback auto-triggered, notify #incidents, and DM oncall. deploy-bot: Include scheduled job to compute metrics and push to experiment infra.

deploy-bot: [automated] rollout created: alt-rerank_v2 -> 10% search-US. Canary window scheduled 2027-05-10T16:00:00Z. Stopping rules attached. (OK)

nina: quick note — need to ensure sampling keys are user_id hashed to avoid crowding heavy users.

marta: @ajay @sam I'll update the feature-toggle YAML and add experiment id. ping me for review before flip.

sam: thanks. :thumbsup:
